# Focused continuation acceptance

Retained product source is commit `71ebedd173aab089260f9085adc581cd9c20f1d4`. The complete [engine CI](https://github.com/carloslfu/slotstream/actions/runs/37538325506), [Mac app CI](https://github.com/carloslfu/slotstream/actions/runs/37538325485) and [context contracts](https://github.com/carloslfu/slotstream/actions/runs/37538325572) pass on that exact source. This includes release safety checks, sampler/governor goldens, the complete native catalogue, build-identity verification, public-library import, instrumented coverage and report generation, app scripted checks and Xcode compilation. Hosted checks use no model weights and are not performance evidence on other Macs.

On the owned development Mac, the release build and unchanged Auto-policy, pack-planning/startup and CLI selection/refusal checks pass. The production Settings rendering suite passes all fifty-four scenarios across Light, Dark and System. The unloaded Auto screenshot was visually inspected; the explanation, source link, separate controls and remaining settings are readable. No real user Home, saved preference or active model was changed by the UI fixtures. Existing original-pack real activation, rollback and runtime-memory evidence is reused from [[sources/runs/2026/10/2026-10-05-real-app-activation-and-memory-controls]]. The retained change affects recommendation explanation and source links, not the independent controls or activation owner.

The initial source commit `99375dd342ed4b4565cb2fe4b868e6206a63ff12` fails one existing coverage-catalogue assertion because its new wording no longer says Auto keeps an accepted installed incumbent. The product wording is corrected without changing that assertion. The local unchanged checks and final complete CI pass. The superseded engine and app workflows are cancelled to free runners after the failure is understood; their cancellation is not a pass. The failed catalogue excerpt and both workflow states remain below.

The native correction-transfer result is separately preserved in [[sources/runs/2026/10/2026-10-06-candidate-correction-lowbudget-result]]. Its timed executable is the earlier frozen, functionally accepted binary, not this presentation-only rebuild. The clean lower-budget pair fails its practical gain criterion, so no research pack enters supported installation or Auto. The fourteen-GB speed pair remains unmeasured; the full same-checkpoint speed promise is still unmet. This record accepts retained implementation and documentation work, not completion of that broader performance goal.
